ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips. Discrete, low-density black clusters and individual spots (mottling) are scattered across the high-intensity white interior, with a larger pigmentation concentration at the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth roughly 1/6th of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep notches, particularly toward the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a relatively straight diagonal trajectory toward the tip. The right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curvature along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A dense cluster of raised, roughly circular, high-contrast white nodes (approx. 8-12 count) localized on the outer distal margin of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark, unaligned linear marks; most prominent are 3-4 parallel streaks on the medial section of the left lobe and several individual marks on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clustering on the right lobe tip and multiple linear rake marks distributed across the ventral pigmentation.
